$comment: VAPP-85: the `Box` style whitelist, verbatim from the VAPP-4 spike (`vapp_spike::WHITELIST` + the logical inline properties the spike added), extended by round 1 (docs/round-1-contract.md) — ONE source for the TS keys (`src/style.ts`), the JSON Schema (`core.schema.json#/$defs/style`) and the Swift/Kotlin/Rust key lists. Numbers are px (≡ pt ≡ dp); `length` also takes `"N%"`, `"Npx"` and `"auto"`; every value may be a token reference `$<group>.<name>` from tokens.json (colours: `#rrggbb[aa]` or `$color.<name>`). `borderWidth` and the four per-side widths are the visual keys with layout effect (a number or `$border.<name>`, VAPP-92); `fontFamily` (VAPP-92) takes only `$type.family.<name>`; `transition` takes only `$motion.<name>` (the duration every opacity/colour/transform/size change animates with; nothing animates without it) and `transitionEasing` only `$ease.<name>`; `transform` is PAINT-ONLY (`translate(Xpx, Ypx)`, `scale(N)`, `rotate(Ndeg)`, space-separated, never layout); `backgroundGradient` = `{angle, stops: [{color, offset 0..1}]}` painted OVER `backgroundColor` (CSS order: the colour shows only through transparent stops); `visibility: hidden` keeps the box in layout and paints nothing (`display: none` removes it); `cursor` is a pointer-platform hint touch platforms ignore. CONDITIONS nest one level and apply in SOURCE ORDER after the base (write narrow-first): `@media` keys match the ONE grammar in `conditions.media` — `min-width`/`max-width`/`min-height`/`max-height` against the SURFACE box (`min-*` = `size >= N`, `max-*` = `size < N`; `N` = px or a `$breakpoint.<name>` token the theme resolves BEFORE matching), `orientation` of the surface box, `hover: hover|none` = a hover-capable pointer, `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce|no-preference` from the platform; the state keys `:hover`, `:focus-visible`, `:pressed` against the node's own interaction state, applied after every media block in that order (pressed wins). `src/style.ts resolveConditions` is the reference flattening and fixtures/style-conditions.json locks it. Still not in v1 (confirmed by the spike, kept by round 1): calc(), named grid lines, gridAutoFlow, justifyItems, order, zIndex (paint order = tree order, absolute nodes LAST among siblings, overlays stack by LAYER), per-side border colours (gpui paints ONE border colour per box; per-side WIDTHS are in), multi-value shorthands. After macro expansion a style VALUE may be a binding or a function call (a bound macro input, e.g. Progress fill width = percent{…}); the renderer resolves it at bind time and then applies it like an authored value; authors cannot write one (validateStyle refuses).
